calendar.title: Calendar
calendar.lead: Block dates, see bookings and sync with Airbnb and Booking.com.
calendar.notInstant: Guests can't book this place on the site yet. Fill in "Bookings and price" to turn on instant booking.
calendar.noUpcoming: No upcoming bookings for this place yet.
calendar.syncLead: Also listed on Airbnb or Booking.com? Connect the calendars both ways to avoid double bookings.
calendar.pickHint: Tap a day, then another day to mark a range. Tap a booking to see its details.
calendar.pickEnd: Tap the last day of the range, or choose an action for this day.
calendar.selected: {count, plural, one {1 day selected} other {{count} days selected}}
calendar.nothingToChange: There are no days to change in this range.
calendar.saveFailed: The calendar wasn't saved. Please try again.
calendar.rateLimited: Too many changes in a short time. Try again in a few minutes.
calendar.bookingUnknown: We couldn't find the details of booking
calendar.importedBody: These dates are blocked because they're taken in the <source></source> calendar.
calendar.importedHelp: To open them, change them there. This calendar updates every hour.

notFound.title: We couldn't find this calendar
notFound.body: The listing may have been deleted, or it isn't yours.

ical.copyFailed: Couldn't copy. Select the link and copy it.
ical.exportBody: Paste this link into Airbnb or Booking.com so dates booked or blocked here are blocked there too.
ical.exportPrivacy: The link only shows which nights are taken, with no names or details. Don't post it publicly.
ical.howToAirbnb: On Airbnb: open the listing's calendar, go to the availability settings and look for "Connect calendars", then "Import calendar". Paste the link and give it a name, for example Bayit.
ical.howToBooking: On Booking.com (Extranet): go to "Rates & Availability", choose "Sync calendars" and add a connection. Paste the link and save.
ical.importBody: {count, plural, one {Paste an .ics link from Airbnb or Booking.com.} other {Paste up to {count} .ics links from Airbnb or Booking.com.}} Nights taken there are blocked here.
ical.feedOk: {count, plural, =0 {Read successfully, no taken dates.} one {Read successfully: 1 event.} other {Read successfully: {count} events.}}
ical.feedNights: {count, plural, =0 {No nights blocked from this calendar yet.} one {1 night blocked from this calendar.} other {{count} nights blocked from this calendar.}}
ical.conflicts: {count, plural, one {1 booking on the site overlaps nights taken in another calendar.} other {{count} bookings on the site overlap nights taken in another calendar.}} Check for a double booking.
ical.addHelp: Copy the link from the calendar export settings on Airbnb or Booking.com. It starts with https.
ical.full: {count, plural, one {You can connect 1 calendar.} other {You can connect up to {count} calendars.}} Remove one to add another.
ical.syncedWithErrors: {count, plural, one {1 calendar couldn't be read. Details are next to the link.} other {{count} calendars couldn't be read. Details are next to the links.}}

errors.unsafe_url: This address can't be used. Please paste a public https link.
errors.feed_missing: The link wasn't found (the calendar may have been deleted or the link replaced). Copy a new link.
errors.http_error: The other site didn't return the calendar. Check the link and try again.
errors.not_calendar: The link doesn't lead to a calendar (.ics file).
errors.too_large: The calendar file is too large.
errors.unreachable: We couldn't reach the other site. We'll try again at the next sync.
errors.failed: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.own_calendar: That's Bayit's own link. Paste a link from Airbnb or Booking.com here.
errors.bad_url: Please paste a link that starts with https.
errors.not_bookable: Calendar sync is available for short stays and hotels.
errors.rate_limited: Too many attempts. Try again in a minute.
errors.invalid_input: One of the links isn't valid.

list.title: Bookings of my places
list.lead: Guests book on the site and pay you on arrival. Here are all bookings and your guests' contact details.
list.emptyBody: When a guest books one of your places, the booking shows up here and you get an email and a text.
list.emptyUpcomingBody: Keep your calendar up to date so guests see the right free dates.

details.title: Booking
details.phoneNote: This phone number was verified when the guest booked. Use it only for the stay.
details.phoneHidden: The guest's contact details are shown only for a confirmed booking.
details.phoneHiddenCancelled: This booking was cancelled, so the guest's contact details aren't shown.
details.paidAtCheckIn: The guest pays you on arrival
details.noFees: Bayit takes no payment and no fee for this booking.
details.noShowOn: You reported on {date} that the guest didn't arrive.
details.actionsLead: Cancelling is a last resort: the guest has already planned the trip.

notFound.title: We couldn't find this booking
notFound.body: Check the booking number, or go back to your bookings.

actions.cancelLead: The guest is told at once, and the nights open again in your calendar.
actions.reasonTextRequired: A few words about the reason (required)
actions.cancelWarning: Every host cancellation is logged and reviewed by our team. You can't cancel because of who the guest is: that's the Bayit pledge.
actions.cancelled: The booking was cancelled. The guest has been told.
actions.noShowBody: Report that {name} didn't arrive for the stay?
actions.noShowNote: We record the report. Nobody is charged.

admin.title: Bookings
admin.description: Host cancellations flagged for review, reports of guests who didn't arrive, and the latest bookings.
admin.hoursAfter: {count, plural, =0 {less than an hour after booking} one {1 hour after booking} other {{count} hours after booking}}
